changedPathRationale.migration: durable non-null invite expiry, revocation actor/timestamp and active-token indexes
changedPathRationale.service: tenant-scoped invite creation, atomically resolved opaque token, explicit expired/revoked/not-found outcomes and durable revocation
changedPathRationale.routes: minimal unauthenticated token resolver before auth middleware plus authenticated tenant-scoped revoke; public response excludes recipient, tenant and token
changedPathRationale.tests: real PostgreSQL invite, expiry, revoke, malformed token, tenant, concurrency and independent cold-read proof
changedPathRationale.evidence: combines the new missing half with already-integrated access-matrix/anonymous-wall and exactly-one-candidate proofs

commands.command: DATABASE_URL=<fresh-intbvp-pg> DB_TYPE=postgres NODE_ENV=test npm run db:migrate:strict
realPG vitest: interviewInviteGovernance + interviewGetSessionAccessMatrix + interviewCandidateExactlyOnce; retry=0

fixtures.database: fresh disposable pgvector/pgvector:pg16 in consultify-int-bvp-fresh on localhost:55490
fixtures.invite: unique anonymous interview session, opaque 256-bit distribution tokens and isolated organizations
fixtures.access: session owner, elevated ADMIN, direct assignee, team assignee, unrelated same-org member and foreign-org ADMIN
fixtures.coldRead: new pg.Pool(max=1) reads terminal expired status independently

negativeControls.expiry: expired token returns 410 INVITE_EXPIRED and terminal state persists
negativeControls.revocation: revoked token returns 410 INVITE_REVOKED; second revoke is denied without rewriting provenance
negativeControls.publicWall: public response contains no recipient email/name, organization id or raw token
negativeControls.tenant: foreign organization cannot create against owner session or revoke owner invite; cross-org session read remains IDOR-safe 404
negativeControls.anonymous: unrelated/elevated non-respondent denied; legitimate team participant receives redacted content; respondent retains own content
negativeControls.access: OWNER, ADMIN on identified session, direct assignee and team assignee allowed; unrelated member denied
negativeControls.concurrency: resolve/revoke race converges on durable revoked state and all subsequent token reads fail closed
negativeControls.candidate: both writers, replay and concurrency converge on exactly one candidate

rollback.code: revert the four bounded implementation/test paths before deployment; no commit was created
rollback.data: additive nullable-to-backfilled governance columns and indexes; existing invites receive a seven-day expiry; no production DB was touched
